title: Country-Pop Icon Shania Twain Shares Rare Photo With Husband - NewsBreak
text: Shania Twain seems to be enjoying some downtime from performing, traveling and taking in sights during a trip to Europe with her husband, Frédéric Thiébaud . The country-pop icon took to social media on Wednesday, Aug. 20 to post a "fun story" about a theater production she recently attended—and along with it came a smiley snapshot with her rarely-seen spouse of 14 years. "A while back, the lovely Rosamund Pike reached out to ask if Man! I Feel Like A Woman! could be used in a new play that she was the lead in - and of course I said yes! The universe worked its magic because while Inter Alia is on at the National Theatre in London, some exciting projects brought me here too," the Instagram upload was captioned. It continued: "I had the privilege of seeing the show last night… it was raw, it was powerful and Rosamund was absolutely incredible. What a fantastic show! And I’m so glad we got to connect after as well, she’s a beautiful person!" 🎬 SIGN UP for Parade’s Daily newsletter to get the latest pop culture news & celebrity interviews delivered right to your inbox 🎬 Twain posed with Pike in the first two images of the three-slide gallery, where both women can be seen wearing all black (though the "That Don't Impress Me Much" songstress accessorized with a yellow hat, bringing in a bright pop of color). In the third and final capture, she cozied up to Thiébaud as the couple stood outside in front of a body of water and nighttime cityscape, the Swiss businessman donning an orange knit sweater with dark jeans and black sneakers. It was a rare sighting, as the songstress is known to keep her personal life private for the most part. One might simply call Twain and Thiébaud's marriage fate, but their road to romance was anything but ideal. Prior to sparking up a relationship with one another, they were married to each other's ex-spouses . The singer tied the knot with her first husband, Robert "Mutt" Lange , in 1993, later welcoming son Eja D'Angelo Lange together in 2001. The former pair separated in 2008, after Robert allegedly had an affair with Thiébaud's then-wife, Marie-Anne Thiébaud , whom was Twain's assistant, and friend, at the time. Frédéric, meanwhile, shares one child with Marie-Anne: daughter Johanna , also born in 2001. Following the "Man! I Feel Like a Woman" singer's 2010 divorce, she remarried in an intimate Puerto Rican ceremony on New Years Day 2011; she and Frédéric have remained together ever since.
